import java.util.Scanner;

public class Main {
    static final int MAX = 100005;
    static final long MOD = 1000000007;
    static long[] d = new long[17];

    static long calc(long num, int level) {
        if (level == 0) {
            return (num == 0) ? 0 : MOD;
        }
        long quotient = num / d[level];
        if (num % d[level] == 0) {
            return level * quotient;
        }
        long res1 = calc(Math.abs(num - d[level] * (quotient + 1)), level - 1) + level;
        long res2 = calc(num - d[level] * quotient, level - 1);
        return Math.min(level * (quotient + 1) + res1 - level, level * quotient + res2);
    }

    public static void main(String[] args) {
        Scanner sc = new Scanner(System.in);
        d[1] = 1;
        for (int i = 2; i < 17; ++i) {
            d[i] = d[i - 1] * 10 + 1;
        }
        long n = sc.nextLong();
        System.out.println(calc(n, 16));
        sc.close();
    }
}
